scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run seed
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build:render: npm install --include=dev --prefix backend && npm install --include=dev --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend && node scripts/copyFrontend.js
